headline: Vote on a "Vote of No Confidence" resolution regarding Mayor Brian A. DePeña, plus discussion of Attorney General complaints against a public officer.
summary: The committee will consider new business including a resolution on Mayor Brian A. DePeña and a discussion of complaints or charges from the MA Attorney General concerning a public officer. Several older tabled items on police and fire service, trash pickup, economic property plans, and MCAS assessments are also listed.
items: 403/26 Adoption of a "Vote of No Confidence" Resolution regarding Mayor Brian A. DePeña – Council President Rodriguez, Vice President Levy and Councilor Infante
404/26 Discussion regarding Complaints or Charges issued by the MA Attorney General concerning a Public Officer – Counc. President Jeovanny Rodriguez
236/24 Home Rule Petition Establishing Credible Service for Police and Fire – Counc. Vice President Stephany Infante (ref. to Citty Attorney and Retirement Director)
329/22 Trash pickup issues within the City of Lawrence - Councilor Rodriguez, Councilor Celina Reyes and Councilor Levy
63/22 Kennedy School of Government Preliminary "Lawrence Vision for Economic Property" - Carras Community Investment, Inc. and Tauben Center-Mayor Brian A. DePeña
213/21 Eliminate MCAS assessments and use that money to teach Life Skills K-12, Vocational/Creative-Hands on activities - Counc. De La Cruz
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
